populationFilter.description: Excludes records with child/adolescent/infant age indexing but no adult age indexing, or explicit paediatric/neonatal title wording. Adult age indexing or adult/mixed-age title context takes precedence. Mixed-age and age-unclear records are retained. This is a screening heuristic, not confirmation of adult-only eligibility.
